- **39f0ea14** · [programming-task] Core: release/unclaim primitive + force-move (transition-exempt) — pi · #bug
  P0 — fixes the one-way-door problem found in dogfooding. (1) POST /cards/:id/release: clears owner, optionally reverts status, EXEMPT from transition enforcement, emits owner_changed+status_changed events. Inverse of claim. (2) Force-move: a `force` flag on PATCH status (or X-Work-Cards-Force header) that bypasses the transition graph but records the force-move in the event diff so the audit trail is honest. Core service + store + tests. No UI yet (separate card). Unblocks claiming-the-wrong-card recovery and retriage.
- **a1bd49a3** · [programming-task] Fix idempotency: wrong actor + schema PK allows cross-actor overwrite — pi · #bug
  Two compounding bugs. (1) The idempotent() wrapper calls actorFromCtx() which reads context+default user, but withActor() hasn't run yet (idempotent is the OUTER wrapper), so lookup/record always use default_user regardless of X-Work-Cards-Actor header. Fix: use resolveActor() (reads header/env/default) in the idempotent wrapper. (2) idempotency_keys PK is `key` only; GetIdempotency filters key+actor but INSERT OR REPLACE overwrites another actor's row for the same key. Fix: PRIMARY KEY (key, actor). Add tests with X-Work-Cards-Actor != default user.
- **8e263901** · [programming-task] Guard nil/empty-index panics: main.run rest[0] + uiCreateCard ct.Name — pi · #bug
  Two panic paths on bad input. (1) cmd/cards main.run: peelGlobals consumes global flags (e.g. `cards --json`) leaving rest empty, then rest[0] panics. Fix: check len(rest)==0 after peelGlobals, return usage error. (2) httpapi uiCreateCard: on CreateCard error with an invalid type_id, the re-render path does `s.baseData("New "+ct.Name)` where ct is nil → nil deref panic. Fix: nil-check ct before the error re-render, fall back to a generic title. Add tests for both.
- **27232d27** · [programming-task] Harden store error mapping: GetCard/ClaimAtomic swallow DB errors as 404/empty — pi · #bug
  Two fail-soft paths mask infrastructure failures. (1) Service.GetCard maps ANY store error to NotFound(404), so a DB outage looks like 'card not found'. Fix: distinguish sql.ErrNoRows (→404) from other errors (→500 internal_error). Apply to all Get* paths. (2) Store.ClaimAtomic returns (nil,nil,nil) on scanCard error, treating DB errors as 'nothing matched'. Fix: return the error so callers can distinguish empty-result from failure. Also: event/FTS insert errors inside ClaimAtomic tx are ignored (_) — surface or log them.
- **f809d58d** · [programming-task] Reconsider RemoveEntry CAS: HTTP DELETE passes version=0, skipping concurrency guard — pi · #bug
  Service.RemoveEntry treats version==0 as 'no CAS' (skip the version check), and the HTTP DELETE handler passes 0 unconditionally. So concurrent entry deletes can clobber each other without a 409. Either: (a) require version on DELETE and return 409 on stale, or (b) document that entry deletes are last-writer-wins by design. Decide and implement/test accordingly.
- **30fbc175** · [programming-task] Return 400 on invalid cursor / SSE Last-Event-ID instead of silently ignoring — pi · #bug
  ListCards and the SSE handler silently ignore unparseable cursors (DecodeCursor error → no filter → first page; bad Last-Event-ID → atoiSafe returns 0 → replay from start). This hides client bugs. Fix: return 400 validation_failed on a malformed cursor; return 400 on a non-numeric Last-Event-ID. Low severity but improves debuggability.

  Concurrency hardening prompted by the serverless CLI (server + direct CLI can write one DB file). DSN: _txlock=immediate (BeginTx grabs the write lock up front, so read-then-write txns like ClaimAtomic/take-next avoid SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT which busy_timeout can't retry), synchronous=NORMAL (safe/fast under WAL). SetMaxOpenConns(1) serializes access to the single file. Added TestTakeNextConcurrent (8 goroutines drain 30 cards, each claimed exactly once, passes under -race).

- **f30a6618** · [programming-task] Events: condition events + monitors (WIP, time-in-status, empty lane, idle)
  Declarative board 'monitors' -> condition events on the bus. Instant (eval synchronously after the triggering mutation): wip_exceeded/cleared, lane_drained/refilled, card_blocked/unblocked. Temporal (status_timeout, card_idle): emitted by a monitor-evaluator goroutine beside the hook supervisor, driven by a deadline min-heap (sleeps until the earliest deadline, NO fixed tick; empty heap = no wakeups). Deadlines armed from a denormalized status_since column + a fired-marker keyed by (card,status,status_since); reconstructible from state, nothing persisted. Lazy/refcounted: deadlines scheduled only while a monitor has a live consumer (SSE filter, hook/webhook, or persist:true), dropped when the last consumer disconnects. Idempotent crossing-state tracking; core emits only, never acts. See docs/INTEGRATION.md.

- **47ab05bc** · [programming-task] take-next: retry to next candidate on a raced/lost claim
  ClaimAtomic returns nil on a lost CAS (another claimant won); TakeNext then returns empty even if other unowned cards remain, so a caller can see 'nothing available' under contention. With MaxOpenConns(1) in-process this can't happen, but cross-process (server + serverless CLI) still can. Fix: loop in ClaimAtomic/TakeNext to advance to the next candidate (bounded attempts) instead of returning nil on RowsAffected==0.

- **a1bd49a3** · [programming-task] Fix idempotency: wrong actor + schema PK allows cross-actor overwrite — pi · #bug
  Two compounding bugs. (1) The idempotent() wrapper calls actorFromCtx() which reads context+default user, but withActor() hasn't run yet (idempotent is the OUTER wrapper), so lookup/record always use default_user regardless of X-Work-Cards-Actor header. Fix: use resolveActor() (reads header/env/default) in the idempotent wrapper. (2) idempotency_keys PK is `key` only; GetIdempotency filters key+actor but INSERT OR REPLACE overwrites another actor's row for the same key. Fix: PRIMARY KEY (key, actor). Fix: check len(rest)==0 after peelGlobals, return usage error. (2) httpapi uiCreateCard: on CreateCard error with an invalid type_id, the re-render path does `s.baseData("New "+ct.Name)` where ct is nil → nil deref panic. - **27232d27** · [programming-task] Harden store error mapping: GetCard/ClaimAtomic swallow DB errors as 404/empty — pi · #bug
  Two fail-soft paths mask infrastructure failures. (1) Service.GetCard maps ANY store error to NotFound(404), so a DB outage looks like 'card not found'. Fix: distinguish sql.ErrNoRows (→404) from other errors (→500 internal_error). Apply to all Get* paths. (2) Store.ClaimAtomic returns (nil,nil,nil) on scanCard error, treating DB errors as 'nothing matched'. Fix: return the error so callers can distinguish empty-result from failure. - **f30a6618** · [programming-task] Events: condition events + monitors (WIP, time-in-status, empty lane, idle)
  Declarative board 'monitors' -> condition events on the bus. Instant (eval synchronously after the triggering mutation): wip_exceeded/cleared, lane_drained/refilled, card_blocked/unblocked. Temporal (status_timeout, card_idle): emitted by a monitor-evaluator goroutine beside the hook supervisor, driven by a deadline min-heap (sleeps until the earliest deadline, NO fixed tick; empty heap = no wakeups). Deadlines armed from a denormalized status_since column + a fired-marker keyed by (card,status,status_since); reconstructible from state, nothing persisted. Lazy/refcounted: deadlines scheduled only while a monitor has a live consumer (SSE filter, hook/webhook, or persist:true), dropped when the last consumer disconnects. Idempotent crossing-state tracking; core emits only, never acts. See docs/INTEGRATION.md.

Fix: loop in ClaimAtomic/TakeNext to advance to the next candidate (bounded attempts) instead of returning nil on RowsAffected==0.
